method: Graph-CB-style blur, threshold, component filtering, skeletonization and contraction applied to each static photo at maximum 800 px. Two threshold policies: fixed 30 and Otsu. Candidate graphs quarantined after acquisition-domain review.
reason: These are perspective/group photographs of damaged strips, not the registered side-on single-specimen compression frames used by the displacement task. Full-image threshold skeletons follow illumination, paper surfaces and background structures, so physical nodes/edges and material identity are not trustworthy. A nonempty graph is not acceptance.
visual_review: All 22 Otsu overlays inspected in contact sheet; numerous nodes/edges follow paper backing, laboratory background and lighting boundaries instead of the physical cross-section. No candidate graph accepted.
